format: PE32+ AMD64; ordinary text, read-only data, writable data and runtime function table
discovery: Locate the Godot GDScript::load_byte_code function-name string; find its RIP-relative code references; identify the enclosing function through the PE runtime function table; enumerate references to writable data in that function

verification.method: Godot 3 GDEC AES-256-ECB format, checked against official engine source; Windows system cryptography used for local verification

assessment: Verified key recovery and complete script decryption for this recognizable Godot 3 Windows x64 export layout. The game uses a separate PCK, so both EXE and PCK are needed. The existing app still requires an executable-inspection importer, validated per-game key handling, and Godot 3 runtime key configuration before startup. This does not establish arbitrary executable support or full game/iPhone compatibility.
